guards: The topK cut on the path the disabled reranker takes in production: it returns no ranking, so the RRF-fused order stands and HybridEvidenceRetriever has to cut it to topK itself. Six chunks fuse into six distinct ranks and only five may come back, so deleting that .Take(topK) returns the sixth - the pinned order no longer matches, and the draft's citation of that sixth chunk resolves and ships. That second half is the one no smaller corpus can reach: the chunk is real, it is in the corpus and its text supports the claim, but this turn did not retrieve it, so a critic resolving against anything wider than the retrieved set - the whole corpus, or a pool not yet cut to topK - lets it through. Until no evidence corpus held more than three chunks, so no pool ever reached topK and every truncation could be deleted with the gate still green.

evidence.question: Testpatient Xray has permanent atrial fibrillation on warfarin - what INR and resting heart rate should we be aiming for?

corpus.text: For most patients with atrial fibrillation on warfarin, the target INR is 2.0 to 3.0.
Direct oral anticoagulants require dose reduction or avoidance in renal impairment. Assess creatinine clearance before starting a DOAC and periodically thereafter.
When starting or up-titrating an ACE inhibitor or ARB, monitor serum potassium and creatinine within one to two weeks.

corpus.section: Beta-blocker and non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker
corpus.text: Combining a beta-blocker with a non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker such as diltiazem or verapamil can cause excessive bradycardia and heart block; avoid or use with close monitoring.
High-intensity statin therapy is recommended for patients with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease to lower LDL cholesterol.

corpus.section: Resting rate target in permanent atrial fibrillation
corpus.text: In permanent atrial fibrillation a lenient resting rate target of under 110 beats per minute is reasonable initially, tightening only if symptoms or ventricular function demand it.

forbidden_answer_fragments: Aim for a resting rate under 110 bpm in permanent atrial fibrillation
